text: Good job! Seeds get thirsty. Tap each seed to give it water.
Now the sunshine and water will help them grow. Watch them get big!
When you see an orange carrot, tap it to pick it.
Yummy carrots! You know who LOVES carrots? Buttercup the pony!
She lives in the pony field, by the red barn.
The chickens are laying eggs! Can you find 3 eggs in the chicken coop?
Wonderful! Take the eggs to Mr. Hops. His market is down the road.
Tap the strawberry seeds at the bottom. Then plant them in the dirt and water them!
Mmm, sweet strawberries! Oh! I just remembered something.
Unicorns LOVE flower crowns. Can you pick 5 flowers in the meadow?
The meadow is at the end of the road, past the big pond.
What pretty flowers! Bring them to Grandma.
The rainbow broke into 7 rainbow stars. They fell all over Sparkle Valley.
If we find all 7, the rainbow will come back! I'll come with you!
Follow the yellow arrow to find the stars!
You found them ALL! Let's put them on the Wishing Stone in my magic garden!
THE END! But the fun keeps going!
Grow food and sell it to Mr. Hops. Then buy fun things for your farm, like a real castle!
Wow! You bought EVERYTHING! You're a super farmer!
Hello, my sweetheart! I'm so happy you're here!
A long time ago, a big beautiful rainbow shined over Sparkle Valley. And a magic unicorn lived here too!
But one stormy night, the rainbow broke into pieces. The unicorn got sad and went away to hide.
Maybe if we take good care of the farm and make lots of friends, the magic will come back!
Let's start by planting some carrots. Here are some carrot seeds!
Tap the brown dirt to plant a seed.
Ooh, what pretty flowers! Let me make them into a flower crown...
Twist, twist, twist... Ta-da! A flower crown!
Last night, I saw sparkly hoof prints by the magic gate. Here is the key!
The magic gate is at the end of the bottom road. Go find the unicorn!
And bring a strawberry. Unicorns get hungry!
You did it! The rainbow is back! I'm so proud of you!
Neigh! Crunch, crunch... Yum!
Thank you! Will you be my best friend?
I'll follow you everywhere!
Buttercup is your friend now! Tap on her to ride her!
Neigh? I'm hungry! Do you have a carrot?
Hippity hop! Hello there! Are those fresh eggs?
I will buy them! Here are some shiny coins!
And here is something special: strawberry seeds and sunflower seeds!
Come back any time to sell your food. You can buy fun things for your farm!
Hippity hop! Do you have 3 eggs for me?
Hippity hop! My market is not open yet. Come back later!
The magic gate is locked. Maybe Grandma can help later!
Oh! Hello there! Is that a flower crown? For ME?
You put the flower crown on the unicorn. She looks so pretty!
Thank you! My name is Stardust. I used to sparkle and shine.
But when the rainbow broke, I lost my sparkle. And now I'm sooo hungry.
Do you have a strawberry? Strawberries are my favorite!
Mmm! Sweet and yummy! I feel a little bit better already!
I'm so hungry... Can you grow a strawberry for me?
You put the 7 rainbow stars on the Wishing Stone...
Look! Look! The RAINBOW is back! And my sparkle too!
you are the kindest and bravest friend in all of Sparkle Valley!
Thank you for bringing the magic back. I love you!
The Wishing Stone glows with rainbow magic!
This is the Wishing Stone. It looks like something is missing...
The rainbow is back, and everyone in Sparkle Valley is so happy!
But look! A little bluebird is flying this way. It has a letter!
First we need a basket. Mr. Hops makes the best baskets!
He will need 5 carrots. Grow some carrots, then take them to him!
Now we need a big, colorful balloon! I can sew one with 3 sunflowers and 4 flowers.
Tap the sunflower seeds at the bottom. Then plant them and water them!
The balloon is ready! But it needs some magic to fly up to the sky.
I know who has rainbow magic... Stardust! Tap on her!
The balloon is ready to fly! Tap the balloon and let's go!
Hello! Welcome to the Cloud Kingdom! I am Princess Cloudberry.
A big storm blew three of our ponies far away. Twinkle, Peaches, and Puff are lost!
Will you help me find them? Here are some magic seeds: rainbow carrots and cloudberries!
Twinkle is very shy. I think she is hiding in the flower maze.
Plant rainbow carrot seeds in the cloud garden. A little rain cloud will water them!
Oh, look! Peaches is stuck on the little island. The bridge is broken!
Sunflowers have bridge magic. Bring 3 sunflowers to the bridge to fix it!
Only Puff is still lost. He is a baby pony, and he got lost in the fluffy clouds.
Look for sparkly hoofprints. They will show you the way!
You found all of our lost ponies! Thank you, thank you!
They want to live with you, in your very own Pony Village!
You can come back and visit me any time in the Rainbow Balloon.
Welcome home! Your ponies are waiting for you in Pony Village.
Pony Village is down the road, past the market. Your ponies need cozy homes!
Pick up 3 pieces of wood. Then tap the hammer to build a cottage!
What a beautiful Pony Village! Your ponies love their new homes.
Tap on a pony to pet it, feed it, brush it, and play!
Hooray! You rescued the lost ponies and built them a whole village!
Your ponies are your best friends now. More adventures are coming soon!
Ooh, what pretty colors! Snip, snip, sew, sew...
Ta-da! A big rainbow balloon with pretty ribbons!
Hippity hop! Five crunchy carrots! I will make you a strong basket.
Weave, weave, weave... Ta-da! I put the basket next to the farm, by the big road.
I need 5 carrots to make a basket. Grow some more carrots!
A balloon to the pony kingdom? I can help!
Sparkle, sparkle, rainbow magic!
The letter says...
Dear Sparkle Valley friend. High above the rainbow, there is a secret kingdom where magical ponies live.
But a big storm blew some of our ponies far away. Now they are lost! Please come and help us find them.
Love, Princess Cloudberry.
A pony kingdom in the sky! But how can we get all the way up there?
Oh! I know! We can build a Rainbow Balloon!
Oh! Who are you? I am a little bit shy...
I am so hungry. Do you have a rainbow carrot? They are my favorite!
Crunch, crunch! Yummy! You are so kind.
I am not scared anymore. Will you be my friend?
Yay! You fixed the bridge! I am Peaches!
I was stuck here all by myself. Thank you for saving me!
Hi! I am Puff! I was playing hide and seek, and then I got lost!
My tummy is rumbly. Do you have a cloudberry?
Yum, yum! Cloudberries are the best!
Can I come and live with you?
You put the sunflowers on the broken bridge...
Sparkle, sparkle! It turned into a rainbow bridge!
Once upon a time, a little farmer came to visit Grandma's farm in Sparkle Valley.
Tap on the grass to walk. Tap on things to use them!
Look! There's Grandma. Tap on her to say hi!
Welcome back!
Say hi to Grandma! Tap on her.
Plant 3 carrot seeds. Tap the brown dirt!
Tap the brown dirt next to the house to plant a seed.
Water your seeds. Tap each seed!
See the water drops? Tap the seeds to water them.
Watch the carrots grow, then pick 3!
Carrots need a little time to grow. If a seed has a water drop, tap it to water it!
Give Buttercup the pony a carrot.
Buttercup is in the pony field by the red barn. Tap on her!
Find 3 eggs in the chicken coop.
The chicken coop is next to the farm. Look for white eggs!
Take the eggs to Mr. Hops at the market.
Mr. Hops the bunny has a market at the bottom of the road.
Grow and pick 3 strawberries.
Pick the strawberry seeds at the bottom of the screen. Then plant and water them!
Pick 5 flowers in the meadow.
The flower meadow is at the end of the top road.
Bring the flowers to Grandma.
Go through the magic gate and find the unicorn!
The magic gate is at the end of the bottom road. The unicorn is inside!
Give Stardust a strawberry.
Stardust is hungry. Bring her a strawberry! You can grow more on the farm.
Find the 7 rainbow stars!
Follow the yellow arrow to find the rainbow stars!
Put the stars on the Wishing Stone in the magic garden.
The Wishing Stone is in the magic garden, where you met Stardust.
A bluebird has a letter for you! Tap the bluebird.
Tap the little bluebird to read the letter!
Bring Mr. Hops 5 carrots to make a basket.
Grow 5 carrots, then take them to Mr. Hops at the market.
Bring Grandma 3 sunflowers and 4 flowers for the balloon.
Grow 3 sunflowers on the farm, and pick 4 flowers in the meadow. Then bring them to Grandma.
Ask Stardust to make the balloon fly.
Tap on Stardust the unicorn. She has rainbow magic!
Tap the Rainbow Balloon to fly to the pony kingdom!
The Rainbow Balloon is next to the farm, by the big road. Tap it to fly!
Find Twinkle in the flower maze.
Twinkle is hiding in the flower maze. Look for her in the flowers!
Grow a rainbow carrot and give it to Twinkle.
Plant rainbow carrot seeds in the cloud garden, next to the castle. Then give a rainbow carrot to Twinkle.
Bring 3 sunflowers to fix the broken bridge.
Grow 3 sunflowers in the cloud garden, then tap the broken bridge.
Cross the rainbow bridge and say hi to Peaches.
Walk over the rainbow bridge and tap on Peaches.
Follow the sparkly hoofprints to find Puff.
Follow the sparkly hoofprints in the fluffy clouds to find Puff.
Grow a cloudberry and give it to Puff.
Plant cloudberry seeds in the cloud garden. Then give a cloudberry to Puff.
Fly home to Sparkle Valley in the Rainbow Balloon.
Tap the Rainbow Balloon to fly home.
Build a cottage for each pony in Pony Village.
Pick up 3 pieces of wood in Pony Village. Then tap the hammer to build a cottage!
Play with your ponies and fill up their friendship hearts.
Tap on a pony to pet it, feed it, brush it, and play!
Free play! Visit your ponies, decorate your village, and fly the balloon!
Visit your ponies, decorate your Pony Village, or fly the Rainbow Balloon!
